segments.title: Carry the sun
segments.sub: Every night the sun crosses the Maya underworld. Tonight, you carry it.

segments.title: Swipe. Leap. Slide.
segments.sub: Three lanes along a temple causeway in the dark.

segments.title: Tap to flare
segments.sub: Light the road. Turn jaguars to stone.

segments.title: Mind the bats
segments.sub: Flare too much and they dive at you.

segments.title: Keep your light alive
segments.sub: Here the stone drains fast. Grab every sun-drop.

segments.title: Six deadly Houses
segments.sub: Each with its own rules and its own look.

segments.title: Outrun the jaguars
segments.sub: Let your light die and the pack catches you.

segments.title: Make it to dawn
segments.sub: Then the next night runs faster.

segments.title: Choose your runner
segments.sub: Runners, outfits, hats and stone hues.

segments.title: 24 glyphs to earn
segments.sub: Each one drawn like a scribe's sign.

segments.title: A new road every day
segments.sub: Everyone runs the same causeway. Climb the ranks.
